## Decision

TypeScript compiled with Bun to a single gw binary; hooks become one-line shims invoking gw hook <name>; kills the .mjs/.d.mts split; one shared Zod schema for frontmatter across CLI and hooks. Plugin (hooks/skills/agents) remains the delivery and enforcement surface; a gw mcp server mode is a later, optional slice.

## Rationale

A single compiled binary eliminates the .mjs/.d.mts maintenance burden and gives hooks a stable, typed entrypoint. Bun compiles TypeScript natively without a separate tsc step. Zod schemas shared across CLI and hooks prevent the seam drift that causes parity failures.
